Well, it's a win loss too. In some areas it is, and I'll tell you why, such as the research and development tax credit. That was made permanent for so long that had just been a one, two-year kind of patchwork tax provision. Now we have some certainty there. In agriculture, section 179, business-expensing for small businesses, but very important to agriculture, that was finally made permanent. And that's a huge deal. So that's a big win.
